body:
@sepo-agent /answer

Can you check what are the needed setup for adding https://giscus.app/ -- we already installed the app

comments.body:
Good news: **giscus is already wired up in the codebase** — the component, custom themes (light/dark), and layout placement are all done. The only thing blocking activation is two placeholder IDs in [`quartz.layout.ts`](https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/blob/main/quartz.layout.ts#L79-L83).

I fetched the live values from the GitHub API. Here's what needs to be replaced:

| Field | Current placeholder | Correct value |
|---|---|---|
| `repoId` | `_X_` | `R_kgDOQ1061w` |
| `categoryId` | `_X_` | `DIC_kwDOQ106184C5cJQ` |

**The one change needed** in `quartz.layout.ts` (lines 81–83):

```ts
repoId: "R_kgDOQ1061w",
category: "General",
categoryId: "DIC_kwDOQ106184C5cJQ",
```

Other available discussion categories (if you ever want a different mapping):

| Category | ID |
|---|---|
| Announcements | `DIC_kwDOQ106184C5cJP` |
| **Episodes** | `DIC_kwDOQ106184C7Cda` |
| **General** | `DIC_kwDOQ106184C5cJQ` |
| Ideas | `DIC_kwDOQ106184C5cJS` |
| Q&A | `DIC_kwDOQ106184C5cJR` |

**Verification checklist** (all already done based on the code):
- [x] Giscus GitHub App installed on the repo
- [x] GitHub Discussions enabled (categories exist above)
- [x] `Comments` component implemented with custom light/dark CSS themes
- [x] Placed in layout for all non-index pages
- [x] Dark mode sync via `postMessage`
- [ ] Replace placeholder `repoId` and `categoryId` — **this is the only remaining step**

Want me to open a PR with that one-line change?

**Sepo implementation finished**

- Branch: `agent/implement-issue-18/claude-25068521131`
- Pull request: https://github.com/augmented-mind/augmented-mind.github.io/pull/20

Replaced the placeholder `repoId` and `categoryId` values in `quartz.layout.ts` with the live IDs fetched from the GitHub GraphQL API (`R_kgDOQ1061w` and `DIC_kwDOQ106184C5cJQ` for the General discussion category). The giscus component, custom light/dark themes, and layout wiring were already in place — this single edit activates the comment system.
